prompts.name: town-grand-architecture-v01
prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: original Aurevane fantasy map building sprite atlas. Create exactly EIGHT separate GRAND REGIONAL CIVIC BUILDINGS on one 4-column by 2-row transparent sprite sheet, reading left to right then top to bottom. All eight buildings share a consistent beautiful mature painterly isometric orthographic camera (view from southeast, visible front and right sides), warm upper-left lighting, detailed believable architecture, clear silhouettes, grounded stone thresholds, and no cast-shadow plates. Generous empty transparent margin of at least 12% of each cell on EVERY side; every roof, ornament and ground-contact base entirely inside its own cell; absolutely no overlaps between cells. Each cell contains ONE building only, no panorama, landscape island, text, people, grid lines, labels or watermark. Buildings should feel grand and inhabited, not toy-like, with beautifully tactile material painting and crisp detail. Exact eight cell subjects in row-major order: 0 Verdant Expanse: ancient tree-rooted timber and mossy pale-stone long hall, tall timber gables supported by elegant living roots and leafy tendrils, a restrained green roof. 1 Aureth Crown: stately cream limestone guildhall, layered red terracotta roofs, open grand arched doorway, gold restrained accents, distinct from a castle. 2 Frostmere: snow-laden rugged gray stone great hall, steep slate roof, massive timber beams and warm window lights, correctly settled snow. 3 Hollow Coast: tall weathered harbor warehouse with staggered timber floors, hoist beam and slate shingles, pale sea-worn masonry, no water or boats. 4 Glasswind Desert: ornate warm sandstone domed caravansarai with arcaded entrance, low wings, teal ceramic inlays and canvas awning, several domes but one coherent building. 5 Emberreach: grand basalt foundry with stepped copper roofs and a tall constructed chimney, living green lichen and roof-edge plants, copper/green growth, no lava and no flames. 6 Starfall Highlands: terraced slate observatory on a grounded broad stone stair base, elegant small copper astronomical dome, angular alpine roofs, no floating terrain. 7 Umbral March: tall dark timber watch hall with deep layered green-gray roofs, dignified weathered stone footing and broad inviting entrance, botanical roof growth, no evil anime spikes or skulls. Strongly distinct construction and silhouette for every region. True transparent background and transparent gaps, no backing squares, no ground shadows, no soft colored background haze. The map supplies the floor; keep just the building's real contact stones. Produce a premium finished illustration atlas, not a concept montage.

prompts.name: town-ordinary-architecture-v01
prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: original Aurevane fantasy map building sprite atlas. Create exactly EIGHT separate VARIED REGIONAL ORDINARY BUILDINGS on one 4-column by 2-row transparent sprite sheet, reading left to right then top to bottom. They are beautiful functional vernacular constructions of distinct shapes, not the same house recolored. Match mature richly painted isometric fantasy terrain art, a consistent orthographic isometric camera from southeast (front and right sides visible), upper-left daylight, believable tactile stone, wood, copper, clay and weathering, crisp detailed roof silhouettes and grounded real thresholds. EACH of the eight cells has generous 12% empty transparent margins on all four sides; contain the full roof and footprint within its own cell with NO overlaps or clipping. One building per cell, transparent empty background, no cast shadow, no square/diamond floor plinth, text, watermark, labels, grid lines, landscape or characters. Exact row-major cell order: 0 Verdant Expanse: asymmetrical gabled timber weaver's house with mossy stone lower wall, elegant loom-pattern shutter lattice and a cloth drying rail, growing green ivy. 1 Aureth Crown: narrow cream-limestone tiled townhouse with a taller side stair tower and terracotta roofs, distinctive recessed arched door and window boxes. 2 Frostmere: squat stone and heavy timber roofed workshop with a broad steep snowy roof, short flue and timber storage nook, safe warm window light. 3 Hollow Coast: weathered stilt store with visible short timber posts and cross-braces, exterior loading gallery, salt-worn wood walls, layered gray shingles, NO water underneath. 4 Glasswind Desert: compact arched stucco dwelling, asymmetrical flat terraces, one small domed stairhead, deep teal shutters and hanging fabric shade, sun-worn pale ochre. 5 Emberreach: terraced basalt mason's house with alternating pitched copper roof and open stone terrace, constructed kiln-style chimney, lush living green lichen and plants, NO lava or flames. 6 Starfall Highlands: long low alpine lodge of dark slate and light stone, a stepped gable silhouette, modest copper vents, layered cold-weather textures and hardy green plants. 7 Umbral March: leaf-roof stone house with a curved layered wooden roof and broad low eaves, dark timbers, rounded mossy footing and herb planters, warm inhabited dignity, not spooky or evil. All must sit on their true floors, no levitation. No insignia or copied franchise architecture. Premium finished game-ready illustrations.

prompts.name: crown-wall-kit-v01
prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: original Aurevane Crown defensive architecture modular sprite kit. Create exactly FOUR separate CREAM LIMESTONE WALL CUTOUTS on a 2-column by 2-row sprite sheet. True transparent background, generous 12% empty margin inside EVERY cell all around each sprite, no overlap, full uncut silhouettes. Original mature painterly isometric orthographic architectural art, upper-left warm daylight, consistent cream limestone blocks, believable weathering, restrained gold standard accents, detailed crenellations, matching Aureth Crown elegant medieval civic architecture. No cast-shadow plate, no diamond or rectangle ground base, no text, watermark, labels, grid lines or characters. Exact row-major pieces: TOP LEFT a LONG STRAIGHT crenellated wall run, about three map tiles long, oriented along the northeast-to-southwest isometric ground axis (wall's long top edge slopes up to the right / down to the left), seen clearly in depth with narrow stone footings, no towers attached; TOP RIGHT matching LONG STRAIGHT crenellated wall run about three map tiles, oriented along the opposite northwest-to-southeast axis (long top edge slopes down to the right / up to the left), same height and materials, no towers attached. BOTTOM LEFT a compact corner bastion joining two short perpendicular matching wall returns, a convincing squared stone defensive tower with broad crenellated top and a grounded real stone threshold. BOTTOM RIGHT a GRAND OPEN CITY GATE: two elegant tall cream-limestone gate towers with crenellations and restrained hanging gold banners, joined by an arch with a large wide clearly OPEN dark gateway all the way to its ground-contact floor; no door blocking the opening, no portcullis, no bridge, no paved street extending beyond the gate. Four individual distinct sprites on transparency, not a connected scene. Show thick constructed stone blocks, real mortar joints and physically sound walls. Beautiful and tactical-map readable.
